title: 关系代词的选择

examples.en: The boy who is standing there is my brother.
examples.zh: 站在那边的那个男孩是我弟弟。

examples.en: The book which I bought yesterday is very useful.
examples.zh: 我昨天买的那本书很有用。

guess.question: 先行词指人时用什么，指物时用什么？

options.text: 指人用 who / whom / that，指物用 which / that
options.feedback: 对！先看先行词是人还是物，再看在从句里作主语还是宾语。

options.text: 指人用 which，指物用 who
options.feedback: 不对——正好说反了，which 指物、who 指人。
不对——定语从句里没有 what 这个关系词。

rule.rule: 先行词指人用 who（主格）/ whom（宾格）/ that；指物用 which / that；关系代词在从句中作宾语时可以省略；从句谓语的单复数与先行词保持一致
rule.formula: ① 人作主语：The girl who / that is singing is my sister.　② 人作宾语：The boy (who / whom / that) I met is Tom.（可省）　③ 物：The book which / that I read was interesting.　④ 谓语随先行词：He is one of the boys who are…

anchors.en: The man who lives next door is a doctor.
anchors.zh: 住在隔壁的那个人是医生。

anchors.en: The pen (which) you gave me is very nice.
anchors.zh: 你给我的那支笔很好用。

trap.wrong: The book who I bought yesterday is useful.
trap.right: The book which / that I bought yesterday is useful.
trap.why: book 是物，要用 which / that，不能用 who。

guess_callback: 你刚才选的是 A——人用 who/whom，物用 which，两种都能用 that；作宾语时可以省略。

check.stem: The girl ____ is drawing a picture is my classmate.

options.distractor: whom 作宾语，这里缺主语

check.explanation: 先行词是人且在从句中作主语 → who。

check.stem: This is the book ____ I told you about.
check.explanation: 先行词是物 → which（作宾语也可省略）。

The boy which is playing basketball is Tom.
The boy what is playing basketball is Tom.
The boy whom is playing basketball is Tom.
